task.title: Approve or reject a fix
task.shortdesc: Approve a proposed rule so every later run uses it without the agent, or reject it with a reason.

step.cmd: Read the rule's description and its XSLT.

info.p: Check that it keeps every piece of text and every ID.

step.cmd: Select Approve, or select Reject and say why.

stepresult.p: The decision, who made it and when are added to the rule's provenance and to the audit trail.

step.cmd: From the command line, approve a rule file instead:

result.p: An approved rule runs on every later migration. A rejected rule is kept for the record and never runs.
